hypothesis: On six fixed synthetic idealized antipodal-aperture targets, all allowed-phase, dyadic mass and independent exact arithmetic checks pass, and at least one of the two complex core fixtures has a certified whole-circle residual norm at least 10 percent below BOTH pointwise nearest rounding and the frozen multi-start single/pair-flip greedy baseline. Controls receive no incremental credit. No fixture, threshold, grid or method tuning after outputs.

input.kind: Synthetic equal-spaced linear coherent aperture, coefficients Z_j=r_j*d_j, 0<=r_j<=1 and unit complex rational d_j. Output coefficient is s_j*d_j with s_j in {-1,+1}. No hardware data, optical propagation, coupling, noise, training or practical ultraflat generator.
input.exposure: Source manuscripts and existing qualitative mapping were read before registration. No output word, error norm or finite comparison for these fixtures has been computed. Not blind discovery.

method.scope: Finite exhaustive implementation of the source's joint dyadic discrepancy choice, not a polynomial-time Lovett-Meka implementation or a theorem-constant test. The discrepancy subproblem is exponential, deliberately capped at n<=6.
method.dyadic: Set p_j=(1-r_j)/2 and mu=sum p. J=max(1,ceil(log2 n)); floor p to multiples 2^-J without increasing mass. For h=J..1 take active odd numerators in 2^h*p. Enumerate ALL 2^s active sign vectors. Score max over real and imaginary rows of sum xi_j*d_j*exp(2*pi*i*j*l/(20*n)). Minimize score, deterministic lexicographic xi tie-break. Reverse the selected xi if sum xi>0, then update p+=2^-h*xi. This preserves the exact mass bound and grid membership. Return s=1-2p. Save every stage and selected signs. No final polishing or replacement by the best exhaustive word.
method.optimizer_arithmetic: IEEE Python float complex trig only chooses candidates on the frozen grid. Scores within absolute 1e-12 tie, then lexicographic word. Optimization scores are never certificates. All eligibility, mass and final norm decisions are checked in rational/integer arithmetic.
method.nearest: Pointwise closest antipodal choice s=+1 everywhere, including r=0 ties.
method.greedy: Three starts: all+1, all-1, and alternating +1,-1. At each state evaluate all single and pair flips, select best strictly improving grid complex-modulus supremum (improvement>1e-12), ties lexicographic. Stop each descent at no improving neighbor or shared 1024 distinct word evaluations, then choose the best visited word. Share a cache across starts; report cache misses, hits and termination. No mass constraint on old baseline. Thus the old method is allowed more choices and at least as large an upper budget; no equal-runtime or practical speedup claim.
method.budget: Every score call evaluates the same 20*n points; dyadic counts every enumerated active sign vector, greedy counts distinct evaluated full words. Both capped at1024; observed counts separately reported. Nearest is also scored. Timings are nondeterministic and stored only in manifest, not raw replay data.

judge.grid: Four rational quarter-circle parametrizations z=i^q*((1-t^2)+2it)/(1+t^2), q=0..3,t=l/64,l=0..64. This covers the entire circle with parameter mesh1/64; differs from the float optimizer grid.
judge.exact_arithmetic: Convert rational residual coefficients c_j=(s_j-r_j)*d_j to Gaussian integers a_j=D*c_j using a common denominator D. At z=(u+iv)/d, integer Horner yields P(z)=(Hre+i*Him)/(D*d^(n-1)). Squared norm is exact rational. Max sampled squared norm yields outward64-bit dyadic sqrt lower/upper endpoints.
judge.continuum: On each quarter parameter, |z'|<=2. Because |c_j|=|s_j-r_j| exactly, L=sum j*|s_j-r_j| bounds |dP/dtheta| with theta in radians. Every parameter is within1/(2*64) of a grid point; hence continuum norm<=sample_max_upper+L/64, and >=sample_max_lower. Store full correction, not samples alone.
judge.independent_check: For nearest, joint and greedy outputs, independently compute Gaussian-integer autocorrelations C_k=sum_j a_(j+k)*conj(a_j). At EVERY judge point check the identity |P|^2=(C0+2Re sum_(k>=1) C_k*z^k)/D^2 against direct Horner using cross-multiplied integers. Check Parseval energy<=sample upper squared+slack only via resulting continuum interval. A mismatch is failure, never a claimed theorem counterexample.
judge.word_oracle: Enumerate ALL 2^n eligible words by Cartesian product, independently of optimizer and dyadic stage search. Compute an exact rational sampled maximum and Lipschitz-corrected whole-circle interval for every word. The minimum lower and minimum upper enclose the true optimal eligible-word continuum norm; report interval and all word intervals. It is an independent exact finite arithmetic oracle, NOT exact analytic optimization of the continuous supremum, NOT a speed baseline and NOT the returned algorithm. Check each selected word occurs and agrees with this oracle.
judge.decision: Resolved10percent win iff joint_upper<=9/10*nearest_lower AND joint_upper<=9/10*greedy_lower with BOTH baseline lower endpoints>0. If interval slack prevents a decision, record unresolved and do not refine grid after outputs. Also report baseline wins, no gains and all control invariants.

failure: Any eligibility/mass/budget/cross-evaluation/certificate/control failure, resource violation or absence of a resolved core win. Preserve unfavorable observations and unresolved intervals; no formal rejection without humans, no post-output parameter or fixture changes.
metrics: input n, phases, magnitudes and exact defect mass
dyadic active sets, sign choices, probabilities, mass and step scores
chosen-word Horner/autocorrelation identity at every rational point
whole-circle interval endpoints and Lipschitz correction
distinct objective evaluations and greedy termination
elapsed time and peak traced Python allocation
limits: Finite synthetic idealization only. Old Spencer/LM matrix discrepancy underlies the source too; no novelty claim, universal superiority, validation of asymptotic ultraflat theorem or practical hardware benefit. This tests a method action, distinct from APP-076-01's waveform scope QA. Float optimization is heuristic; final decisions use exact certificates. No random seed: deterministic exhaustive choices; trig platform drift may alter chosen words, so environment is frozen and replay checks them. Human review, second provider and Lean builds absent.
